verdict.rationale: Cline Kanban documents running many agents in parallel from a task board, each card in its own git worktree with auto-commit and dependency chains. YOLO/auto-approve mode lets those agents act without prompts, and scheduled agents persist across restarts independent of a terminal session. However, nothing documents agents sustaining autonomous work for hours or days; the only hands-on report describes a lunch-length unattended run. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-hour or multi-day autonomous runs, independent or hands-on corroboration of parallel Kanban fleets at scale.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can launch fleets of autonomous agents that work in parallel on different tasks for hours or days

citations.quote: Run many agents in parallel from a web-based task board with per-card worktrees, auto-commit, and dependency chains.
Use Cline Kanban to run multiple coding agents in parallel with isolated git worktrees.
Check the box and Cline auto-approves everything: file changes, terminal commands, browser actions, MCP tools, and mode transitions.
Scheduled agents persist across process restarts and run independently of any terminal session.
